meta.name: Pehla Pyaar Less Than 1% Chance
meta.description:
A young Murli Sharma relocates to Patna from Ratlam with his family after his father transfers there. While he struggles with disconnect and isolation from his peers, he encounters Nandini and their blossoming friendship turns into love for Murli. Will Nandini reciprocate his feelings?

Rated U/A 13+ · Returning Series · First aired 5 Aug 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: RND Films · Network: SonyLIV

videos.title: Love At First Sight
videos.overview: A young boy named Murli, who recently moved to Patna with his family, struggles to adjust and decides to leave a note behind before running away from home. While on the run, he encounters Nandini. Will this meeting influence him to change his decision?

videos.title: Little Miss Perfect
videos.overview: Nandini wants to skip school and spend the day with her friends. Meanwhile, Murli is preoccupied with comparing himself to Vikram. Later, Nandini asks Vikram to be the male lead in the school play.

videos.title: Murli Ki Tuitions
videos.overview: Murli discusses tuition classes with his mother. Meanwhile, Nandini’s mother advises her to befriend Vikram. Nandini responds that she plans to meet Murli in the evening to help him with his English studies.

videos.title: Murli Is Disheartened
videos.overview: Murli feels disheartened upon realizing that the girl who likes him isn’t Nandini. Nandini apologizes to Vikram for her harsh remarks. Later, Murli confides his sorrow to Deepu.

videos.title: Murli Ka Horror-Scope
videos.overview: Murli's English skills improve with each passing day. He confides in Nandini that he has no feelings for Shruti. Later, as Nandini grows nervous before the play, Vikram steps in to calm her nerves.

videos.title: Dost Se Kayi Zyada
videos.overview: Nandini visits Vikram after he ignores her calls and tries to persuade him to befriend Murli. However, things take a turn for the worse when Murli and Vikram get into a fight.
